effects: Sets the signer's stETH allowance for spender_ to exactly amount_ (replaces any earlier value; type(uint256).max is never decreased when spent).
formats.shown: Approve stETH: allow to spend {amount} stETH (Unlimited at or above 2^255), with the spender address as a field.

findings.title: approve: interpolatedIntent omits the spender, so the sentence does not say who may spend.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json approve interpolatedIntent "Allow to spend {amount_}"; spender_ is only a field. ERC20RebasableBridged.approve -> _approve(msg.sender, spender_, amount_). Case 0 reads "Allow to spend 100 stETH".

findings.title: approve: spender address types limited to contract, but the code accepts any non-zero address.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json approve field Spender params.types ["contract"]; ERC20RebasableBridged._approve only checks onlyNonZeroAccount(spender_).
findings.fix: Add "eoa" and "wallet" to types, or remove the types restriction.

effects: Burns stETH worth tokenAmount_ from the signer (shares = tokenAmount_ * 10^dec / oracle rate).
Sends that number of shares as wstETH from the stETH contract to the signer (amount set by the oracle rate).
formats.shown: Wrap stETH: wrap {tokenAmount_} stETH, showing the stETH amount only.

findings.title: unwrap: the intent "Wrap stETH" does not name wstETH as the asset the signer gets.
findings.evidence: ERC20RebasableBridged._unwrapShares: _burnShares(account_, sharesAmount_); TOKEN_TO_WRAP_FROM.safeTransfer(account_, sharesAmount_). descriptor.json unwrap intent "Wrap stETH", interpolatedIntent "Wrap {tokenAmount_}".
findings.fix: Use intent "Wrap stETH to wstETH" and interpolatedIntent "Wrap {tokenAmount_} to wstETH".

findings.title: unwrap: the wstETH amount received depends on the oracle rate and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: ERC20RebasableBridged._unwrap: sharesAmount = _getSharesByTokens(tokenAmount_), which uses TOKEN_RATE_ORACLE.latestAnswer(). The amount is not in calldata.

effects: Pulls exactly sharesAmount_ wstETH from the signer into the stETH contract, using the signer's wstETH allowance to this contract.
Mints sharesAmount_ stETH shares to the signer, worth sharesAmount_ * oracle rate stETH.
formats.shown: Unwrap wstETH to stETH: unwrap {sharesAmount_} wstETH, with the wstETH amount as a field.

findings.title: wrap: the stETH amount received depends on the oracle rate and is not shown.
findings.evidence: ERC20RebasableBridged._wrap: _mintShares(to_, sharesAmount_); tokensAmount = _getTokensByShares(sharesAmount_), which uses the oracle rate.

effects: Burns sharesAmount_ stETH shares from the signer, worth sharesAmount_ * oracle rate stETH.
Sends exactly sharesAmount_ wstETH from the stETH contract to the signer.
formats.shown: Wrap stETH: wrap stETH for {sharesAmount_} wstETH, with the wstETH to receive as a field.

findings.title: unwrapShares: the stETH amount that leaves the signer depends on the oracle rate and is not shown.
findings.evidence: ERC20RebasableBridged.unwrapShares: tokenAmount = _getTokensByShares(sharesAmount_); _burnShares(account_, sharesAmount_). Only sharesAmount_ is in calldata.

effects: Moves stETH worth amount_ from the signer to to_ (converted to shares at the oracle rate, rounded down).

findings.title: transfer: recipient types are limited to eoa/wallet, but the code also allows contract recipients.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json transfer Recipient params.types ["eoa","wallet"]; ERC20RebasableBridged._transfer only checks onlyNonZeroAccount(to_) and recipient_ != address(this).
findings.fix: Remove the types restriction or add "contract".

formats.key: transferFrom(address from_, address to_, uint256 amount_)
effects: Spends amount_ of from_'s stETH allowance to the signer (unless it is unlimited).
Moves stETH worth amount_ from from_ to to_. The signer's own stETH moves only when from_ is the signer.
formats.shown: Transfer stETH: send {amount_} stETH to {to_}, with Sender, Recipient and Amount as fields.

findings.title: transferFrom: interpolatedIntent omits the sender, so it reads as if the signer sends their own stETH.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json transferFrom interpolatedIntent "Send {amount_} to {to_}"; ERC20RebasableBridged.transferFrom: _spendAllowance(from_, msg.sender, amount_); _transfer(from_, to_, amount_).

effects: Moves sharesAmount_ stETH shares from the signer to recipient_, worth sharesAmount_ * oracle rate stETH.
formats.shown: Transfer stETH shares: send {sharesAmount_} shares to {recipient_}.

findings.title: transferShares: the amount appears in shares, and the stETH value depends on the oracle rate.
findings.evidence: ERC20RebasableBridged.transferShares: _transferShares(msg.sender, recipient_, sharesAmount_); tokensAmount = _getTokensByShares(sharesAmount_). Case 7 shows "1.5 shares".
findings.fix: None can compute stETH. A label such as "stETH shares (wstETH units)" would help the reader.

formats.key: transferSharesFrom(address sender_, address recipient_, uint256 sharesAmount_)
effects: Spends sharesAmount_ * oracle rate of sender_'s stETH allowance to the signer (unless it is unlimited).
Moves sharesAmount_ stETH shares from sender_ to recipient_. The signer's own shares move only when sender_ is the signer.
formats.shown: Transfer stETH shares: send {sharesAmount_} shares to {recipient_}, with Sender, Recipient and Shares amount as fields.

findings.title: transferSharesFrom: interpolatedIntent omits the sender, so it reads as if the signer sends their own shares.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json transferSharesFrom interpolatedIntent "Send {sharesAmount_} to {recipient_}"; code: _spendAllowance(sender_, msg.sender, tokensAmount); _transferShares(sender_, recipient_, sharesAmount_).

findings.title: transferSharesFrom: the allowance spent is in stETH at the oracle rate and is not shown.
